# Deploy MCP

> Deploy your website in seconds directly from your AI editor.

Deploy MCP is an open-source Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that empowers AI coding assistants (Cursor, Claude Desktop, Antigravity, VS Code, Windsurf) to autonomously build-check, synchronize secrets, and deploy web applications to Vercel without leaving the IDE chat interface.

- **Official Website**: https://deploymcp.vercel.app/
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/Tusharjain-19/deploy-mcp
- **Documentation**: https://github.com/Tusharjain-19/deploy-mcp#readme
- **NPM Package**: https://www.npmjs.com/package/deploymcp
- **Contact & Creator**: https://tusharjain.in/contact

## Quick Start
To set up Deploy MCP in any project:
1. Run setup: `npx deploymcp setup`
2. Connect your free Vercel Personal Access Token.
3. Paste the generated JSON configuration into Cursor (`cursor_settings.json`) or Claude (`claude_desktop_config.json`).
4. In your AI chat prompt, type: `Deploy my website with Deploy MCP`.

## 20 Autonomous Tools Exposed to AI Assistants
- `smart_deploy`: Master pipeline that checks, deploys, auto-polls, and diagnoses failures.
- `detect_project`: Auto-detects Next.js, React Vite, Remix, Astro, Vue, Svelte, or static HTML.
- `check_project`: Runs local dry-run build tests without uploading code.
- `deploy_to_vercel`: Uploads build bundle to Vercel global Anycast edge network.
- `get_deployment_status`: Polls deployment state (BUILDING, READY, ERROR).
- `get_deployment_logs`: Streams real-time build and execution logs.
- `diagnose_build_failure`: Analyzes failed build logs and extracts root-cause fix instructions.
- `validate_env`: Audits required `.env` variables against `.env.example`.
- `scan_env`: Scans local environment key names with values 100% redacted.
- `compare_env`: Compares local keys against active Vercel project environment.
- `sync_env`: Pushes environment variables directly to Vercel via local TLS.
- `create_env_example`: Generates redacted `.env.example` file.
- `git_status`: Verifies git tree cleanliness and branch health.
- `git_commit_and_push`: Commits and pushes branch before deploy.
- `check_env_leak`: Validates git index to prevent committing `.env` files.
- `check_domain_availability`: Checks custom domain availability and suggests alternatives.
- `manage_domain`: Binds custom domains and sets 308 permanent redirects.
- `delete_project`: Permanently removes project after local interactive confirmation.
- `project_report`: Comprehensive readiness audit.
- `check_for_updates`: Checks for newer releases on npm.

## Zero-Trust Security Guarantee
- Secrets are NEVER sent to AI models or LLM prompt contexts.
- Local AST scanner parses variable key names only.
- Secret transmission occurs directly between the local client and Vercel endpoints via encrypted mutual TLS.
